items.text: Yesu kayamazire kugamba ebyo byona, yagambira abegesibwabe ati,
“Nimumanya akwo hasigaire ebiro bibili ekiro kya Pasika kugoba, kandi Omwana w'Omuntu nibaija kumukwasa ababisha kumubamba.”
Aho abakuhani bakuru n'abagurusi b'embaga bateranira omu kikaare ky'Omukuhani Nyamukuru ayabaire nayetwa Kaifa,
batensa okwo barakwata Yesu kitamanyikire bakamwita.
Kyonkai bagamba bati, “Tutamukwatira mu kiro kikuru, rutaija rukaba rushengo omu bantu.”
Yesu kayabaire ali Betania omwa Simoni omubembe,
haija omukazi aina echupa y'eibare einamu amajuta g'eiguzi lihango muno, amugoba agamushesha aha mutwe, aho wenene ali aha meza nalya.
Abegesibwa kabaaboine batyo batamwa, bagamba bati, “Amajuta aga gafaki?
Manyasi gakuguziibwe garugwamu empiha zitali zijege tuziha abanaku.”
Yesu kayabimanyire ababaza ati, “Kubaki nimwita kubi omukazi ogu? Aha rw'enshonga yankolera ekintu kirungi.
Buli kaanya inywe abanaku muba mwinabo, kyonkai inye timulikwija kwikara nanye biro byona.
Okunsiiga amajuta aga omubili gwange, yakikora kuntekateka kuziikwa.
Nimbagambira amazima, hona hona omu nsi mbali amakuru garungi aga gararangwaga, ekyo yakora balikibarura nibamwijuka.”
Omoi omu begesibwa 12 ayayetwaga Yuda Isikariote, akwata omuhanda agya omu bakuhani bakuru,
ababaza ati, “Murampaki kandamubanaga omu mikono?” Bamushashura ebichweka makumi gashatu by'efeza.
Kuruga aho ata nahigiliza obushango bw'okumubanja.
Aha kiro kya mbere ky'Omukate Gutatumbisiibwe, abegesibwa baija ahali Yesu bati, “Noyenda tukushemeleze nkahai mbali oraliira Pasika?”
Abahorora ati, “Mugye omu kigo omw'Omuntu nanka, mumugambire muti, ‘Omwegesa nagamba okwo akanya kagoba; naija kushemeleza Pasika omwawe hamoi n'abegesibwabe.’ ”
Abegesibwa bakora nk'okwo Yesu yabaragiilira, batekateka Pasika.
Eizoba kalyatobeire araagira n'abegesibwabe 12.
Orwo babaire nibaraagira agamba ati, “Mbagambiire amazima, omuli inywe halimu arambanja.”
Bajumara muno, babanza kumubaza omoi omoi bati, “Mukama n'inye?”
Ahorora ati, “Owo twakoza hamoi omu pakuli niwe alikwija kumbanja.
Omwana w'Omuntu naija kufa nk'okwo kyamuhandikirweho, kyonkai alibona ogwo alikwija kubanja Omwana w'Omuntu! Kyakushemeire k'omuntu ogwo yakuba atazairwe.”
Yuda ayamubanzire abaza ati, “Rugaba n'inye?” Yesu amuhorora ati, “Wakigambakwo!”
Kababaire nibaragira, Yesu akwata omukate, asiima, agubegura, aguha abegesibwabe agamba ati, “Tora mulye; ogu mubili gwange.”
Ashuba akwata ekikompe, kayamazire kusiima nakyo akibaha nagamba ati, “Mukinyweho inywena;
aha rw'okuba obu bwamba bwange obw'endagano empya obulikwija kushesheka aha rwa bangi kabagarulirwa entambara zabo.
Mbagambiire, tinkishuba kunywa divai kuhika kiro ekyo ndinywa empya omu bukama bwa Tata.”
Kabamazire kuhoya oruhoya baturuka bagya omw'ibanga ly'Emizeituni.
Aho Yesu agambira abegesibwabe ati, “Omw'itumbi eli nimwija kwiruka mukannagaho. Manya kikahandikwa kiti,
Nikwo Yesu kugenda n'abegesibwabe abo omu mwanya ogulikwetwa Getisameni, abagambira ati, “Mushuntame hanu aha, inye ngye kulinya kushoma enshara.”
Agenda na Petero na batabani ba Zebedayo babili, abanza kujunaara n'okubangaranwa omwoyo.
Abagambira ati, “Omwoyo gwange gwina obujune bungi muno, ndaliire kufa. Mwikare hanu aha. Mutanagira, twikare hamoi.”
Agendaho akatambi kake ajumara ahansi ashaba ati, “Tata, kakilikushoboka ekikompe eki kimpingure; kyonkai bitaba kwo inye ndikwenda, shana bibe okwo iwe olikwenda.”
Agoba abegesibwabe ashanga banagiire. Agambira Petero ati, “Inywe mwalemwa kwikara nanye mutanagiire esaa emoi yonkai?
Mutanagira, mushome enshara mutaija mukagwa omu kilengeso. Omu mazima omwoyo nigwenda kyonkai obunyama bujege.”
Ashuba agenda elya kabili ashaba ati, “Tata, k'ekikompe eki kitalikumpingura ntakinyoire, eky'olikwenda singa kibe.”
Ashuba aija ashanga banagiire, okuba oturo tukaba tubakilize amani.
Ashuba abasigaho ashaba omurundi gwa kashatu, nagamba emigambire yonene.
Aho agoba abegesibwabe ababaza ati, “Mukyanagiire, muhumwire? Leba esaa yagoba, Omwana w'Omuntu baija kumubanja kumunagira abafakare.
Imuka tushangwe nitugenda, leba embanzi yange niy'egyo yaija.”
Yesu kayabaire akyagamb'ebyo, Yuda omoi omw'ikumi na babili aija n'embaga etali nke baina embanda n'erungu, batumirwe abakuhani bakuru n'abagurusi b'embaga.
Embanzi ekashangwa yabahaire akamanyiso negira eti, “Owo ndanywegera niwe wenene, mumukwate.”
Niho honkai agoba Yesu nagamba ati, “Kamelere Rugaba!” Mara amunywegera.
Yesu amubaza ati, “Munywanyi wange, waletwaki?” Nikwo kwija bakamutaho engaro, bakamukwata.
Aho oraleba! Omoi omu bo Yesu yabaire ainabo aimukya omukono ashohorora embanda agitemesa omwiru w'Omukuhani Nyamukuru amutemaho okutwi.
Aho Yesu amugambira ati, “Garura embanda omu kiraro kyayo. Enshonga bona abakwata embanda balimarwaho embanda.
Nolenga oti tinakugambira Tata, aho n'aho akantwekera amahe agashagire 12 ag'abamalaika?
Isi aho ebihandiko bitakatifu biragobelera maki okwo ebi bili by'okubaho?”
Omu kaanya ako Yesu agambira embaga egyo ati, “Mwanzinda n'embanda n'erungu kunkwata nk'omushuga? Buli kiro nashuntamaga Rwensinga n'inyegesa, timukankwataaga.
Kyonkai ebi byona byabaho eby'abarangi bagambire omu bihandiko bitakatifu kabigobelera.” Aho abegesibwa bona bamunagaho, bairuka.
Abakwete Yesu bamutwalira Kayafa Omukuhani Nyamukuru, niho n'abagurusi n'abegesa b'Amateka babaire bateraniire.
Petero yamuhondera nasigara haraimu, agoba nyarubuga omw'Omukuhani Nyamukuru, ataha omunda ashuntama n'abalinzi kuleba enzindo erab'ehai.
Abakuhani bakuru n'orukiiko rwona ruhanyahanyia ebishuba eby'okuhangilira Yesu babone kumwita.
Kyonkai n'orwo bamuhangiliire bingi enshonga tiyazokire n'emoi. Obugenda bw'eirai harugwamu babili
bagamba bati, “Omuntu ogu agambire okwo alikushobora kukambura Rwensinga ya Ruhanga, akashuba akagyombekera ebiro bishatu.”
Omukuhani Nyamukuru ayemelera amubaza ati, “Toina kyakuhorora? Aba nibakutoijera ahali bihai?”
Kyonkai Yesu tiyajegire. Omukuhani Nyamukuru ashuba amugambira ati, “Nakutaho Ruhanga asingiire, tugambire k'oraba niwe Kirisito Omwana wa Ruhanga!”
Yesu agamba ati, “Wakigamba. Kyonkai mbagambire, ahanyuma nimwija kubona Omwana w'Omuntu asingiire aha bulyo bw'Omushobora, naletwa omu bichwi.”
Nikwo Omukuhani Nyamukuru kutagura enyambarwaze akagamba ati, “Yarogota! Abajulizi tukyahiiga baahai? Inywe nywenene mwayehulilira okwo yarogota.
Nimuramuraki?” Bahorora bati, “Naragirwa kufa.”
Aho bamuchwera omu maisho, bamutera. Nangu abandi bamutera empi
nibagamba bati, “Otubaasire, iwe Kirisito! Ayakutera n'ohai?”
Aho Petero akaba ashuntamire aheru omuli nyarubuga. Omuzana aija amugoba agamba ati, “Naiwe waba oina Yesu Omugalilaya.”
Petero ayetonga ekigambo ekyo omu maisho ga bona, nagamba ati, “Eby'olikugamba tindikubimanya.”
Kuturuka ati nagoba omu kishasi omuzana ondijo amubona, agambira ababaire bemeleireho ati, “Omushaija ogu yaba aina Yesu owa Nazareti.”
Petero ashuba ayetonga ekigambo ekyo narahira ati, “Omushaija ogwo inye tindikumumanya.”
Akaanya kagufi kahinguraho ababaire bali aho baija bagambira Petero bati, “Ky'amazima naiwe oli wabo; nangu n'emigambire yawe nekubanja.”
Nikwo kubanza kurahira nayekeena ati, “Inye nti omushaija ogwo tindikumumanya.” Aho n'aho enkokoromi ekookoroma.
Nikwo Petero kwijuka ekyo Yesu yabaire agambire ati, “Enkokoromi etakakokoromire oraba wanyetongire kashatu.” Ashohora alira muno.
